title_zh: 选择河流纪录片的开场画面

scenario.label_zh: 选择河流纪录片的开场画面
scenario.goal_zh: 比较河流素材所呈现的信息，并选定不夸大野生动物活动的开场

context_zh: 纪录片剪辑师与导演为一部本地河流短片选择开场素材。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: As the film-maker, what do you want viewers to notice first?

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: The river itself. Do we have footage of the water before the boats arrive?

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: Yes. There is also a brief glimpse of an otter near the bank, but the image is blurred.

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: I like the imagery of light moving across the water. We do not need the otter to carry the opening.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: Shall I use the clear river shot and save the otter clip for later, with no claim that otters are always there?

sentences.speaker: Arun
sentences.text: Exactly. Start with the river and let the animal appear as the brief encounter it was.
